description: Turn a used Kindle Paperwhite into a quiet, always-on e-ink weather dashboard
rules: Install from a GitHub checkout with uv sync. The project is not published to PyPI or any other package index.
Copy config.example.yaml to config.yaml and edit location, units, and display. Unknown keys, invalid time zones, and out-of-range coordinates are rejected.
Render a frame with uv run paperwhite render --config config.example.yaml --output dashboard.png. Pass --provider open-meteo for live weather. --now must include a UTC offset.
paperwhite serve answers on port 8765 at /health, /dashboard.png, /dashboard/landscape.png, /dashboard/portrait.png, and /skins. Clients configure the server hostname.
Skins are minimal (default), big-clock, forecast, graphic, timeline, weather-station, and newspaper. Switch with --skin, the /skins page, or POST /skin.
On the Kindle, a tap switches orientation and a two-second hold requests the next skin. deploy/install.sh installs the service; set PAPERWHITE_PROVIDER=open-meteo in .env.
